newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo to build air-con plant in China.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo to build air-con plant in China.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Electronics Co said on Wednesday it plans to invest $60 million by the year 2000 to build an air-conditioner plant in Tianjin, China.
Daewoo Electronics, a unit of Daewoo Group, said in a statement $35 million of the planned amount would be spent this year to start operation in early next year.
The plant will have an annual capacity of 100,000 units and the production will be expanded to 300,000 units by the year 2000, the statement said.
Most of the output from the plant would be sold in China, where demand for air-conditioners has grown sharply, it added.
